subject: [PATCH 35/60] mm/mempolicy: keep private nodes out of migrate_pages() destinations

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with private nodes being included as migration destinations, which can lead to allocation failures. Proposed a solution by excluding private nodes from the destination mask.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the Linux kernel's memory policy module, specifically related to migration of pages between nodes. Patch 35 focuses on preventing private nodes from being included as destinations for page migration, which can lead to allocation failures.
